New: Coding tools > Fit a new or used module. Pick the module you fitted and E-Sys MAX tells you what it needs: a blank module (Detect CAF for SWE first), software your PSdZData does not have or from another model (flash it first), secure coding, or ready to code from the car's order.
Then it selects the module on the Coding page, you press E-Sys's Code, and Check the coding reads it back and says whether it is coded for this car.
